model: GA_Adler_Melee admits GE_Player_Adler_Melee1_Damage and advances five ordinary stages (12 hits: 1, 1, 7, 2, 1 across Melee1..5) per adler.normal_chain_v1. Native coefficients at Normal levels 1 and 8 are 3.181 and 5.452 across the chain; category A/INCANTATION metadata stays source-bound. Normal attack receives +1 level from resonance_3 at selection count >= 3. See adler-normal-chain.json.

One admitted ordinary Skill binds GE_Player_Adler_Skill2_Damage once and GE_Player_Adler_Skill3_Damage twice as coincident initial DEF packets, then emits GE_Player_Adler_Skill_Damage at +1s through +10s inclusive on target zero. The mapped Skill2 row and published 70% DEF x3 description disagree about multiplicity; the two Skill3 activations and exact impact/refresh timing remain explicit bounded hypotheses. The 1s/10s frozen DT_AdlerEffectFigure curves ground the DoT train. A single target is supported; broader geometry rejects. Recast replaces the previous train, living owners continue off-field and defeated owners or targets stop future ticks. One Skill admission spends cost once and preserves the Blessing grant.

Connected normal-chain packets add one held Karma stack and aimed Liberation adds two, capped at 20; A1 Burst admission adds 20 up to 20. Skill admission captures and clears held stacks before damage. Each captured stack adds +2 percentage points to additive FinalDamageUp, or +3 points when effect 2 is selected, on every initial and periodic packet keyed to that admitted command, preserving delayed initial packets across recasts. This is an explicit tested hypothesis from optional PC_140 decoded local assets AdlerSkill_DamUp.uasset (local:cde2e6c246e3d5ed5234e1dc7741e35242c66031826484d685b8a653462e16bd) and Buff_AdlerQiHai_SkillDamUP.uasset (local:b0ff9c388aeff5a4a28ba111db07776ba95d2c939d33d31ab844f4e4398f8ade): reconstructed additive FinalDamageUp is .02 per count without A2 and .03 with A2. Their exact hotfix/precedence, Global cutoff applicability and runtime reachability are unproven. The frozen .01 Adler_lv2 figure and localized descriptions conflict; no separate held-stack general A2 bonus is modeled to avoid double-applying this reconstructed Skill carrier. Other Karma producers/consumers remain pending.

The public Burst action delivers GE_Player_Adler_UltraSkill_Damage five times to each living declared target, or ten times to the sole living target, using the exact DEF coefficient: 1.0 at level 1, 1.714 at level 8 and 1.851 at effective level 9 after resonance_3. DT_GameplayAbilityTipsData.Rows.GA_Adler_UltraSkill.AbilityDescription[0].Description specifies five Sunyas, five instances per enemy and a second strike against a sole enemy; the native damage row binds DEF/category Q/Incantation and FixedCritRate 0. adler.burst_sunyas_v1 explicitly captures living population at admission and uses strike-major target order with coincident impact times. Delivery rechecks owner/target survival and live modifiers, preserves off-field ownership, and settles separate crit/proc opportunities. One cast spends its admitted energy cost once. Native intervals and selection time remain hypotheses; a defeat during the captured train does not expand it.

When effect 5 is selected, a successful native Burst admission schedules exactly one same-time ProcCallback for 20 flat Ultimate Energy to the captured Adler. restore_energy bypasses Charge Efficiency and leaves fractional carry unchanged; ordinary capacity/overflow accounting still applies. A defeated captured source receives no refund, and active-field changes do not redirect it. The frozen 1033AwakenEffect.json Effect5 localized text says Adler gains 20 Ultimate Energy when casting Tranquility, and DT_AdlerEffectFigure.Adler_lv5 is 20. The callback timing, living-owner gate and flat restoration are explicit bounded hypotheses; optional PC_140 ChargeExecution20 does not prove runtime wiring. Native applicability and remaining kit interactions stay pending.

Native DEF delivery uses source-projected base DEF, static DEF percent and flat additions separately, then applies live DEF percent to base DEF and live DEF flat additions before generic exact mitigation, crit and damage bonuses. Percent modifiers reject when base-DEF provenance is absent; old requests without typed scaling continue to default to ATK.
Resonance 3 activates at selection count >= 3 and adds +1 level to Skill, UltraSkill, and Melee.
PlayerInput::Special toggles Aim mode (GE_Player_Adler_Aim_Damage); normal chain does not advance during aiming.

On successful GA_Adler_Skill admission, a same-time callback grants the captured active actor a native flat+DEF-coefficient Blessing shield using effective Skill level (including resonance 3), cast-time effective DEF and Adler outgoing ShieldEfficiency. The shield is keyed by granter and recipient, replaces only that key on recast, persists across switching, and expires half-open; A3 adds 20% in the additive ShieldEfficiency zone as a tested hypothesis. Solifugae Vita reads positive nonexpired settled wearer shields at hit delivery and adds its frozen base-ATK-scaled ATK percentage. See adler-blessing-shield.json and q1-snowman/receipt.json.

At hit delivery, one additive +10 percentage-point Incantation damage bonus applies to team packets while a living R6 Adler has a positive, nonexpired Blessing shield on any living actor. Off-field packet owners and active-field switches do not change eligibility; depletion, expiry, recipient death or Adler death turns it off. Multiple eligible Adler sources do not stack. This is a tested bounded hypothesis from 1033AwakenEffect.json resonance_6; the referenced Buff_Adler033_Level6_extra blueprint does not expose the native property or protected-actor scope. DamageUpIncantationBase is the matching native-style bonus property; the model uses the existing additive damage-bonus zone.

Effect4 establishes the break trigger and a 50%-of-Adler-DEF basis. Because its referenced blueprint is unavailable, live settlement-time DEF instead of cast-time DEF, nearest-integer rounding, one-event cap, living-source eligibility, no ShieldEfficiency/A3 multiplier, no stored remainder, and first-broken-shield ordering across multiple sources are bounded choices. The chosen rule applies after ordinary shields and before HP/overkill; exact depletion records zero absorption. Expiry/removal/replacement do not trigger, and no shield/heal/revival is created.
